WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        o.branch_id,
        oi.product_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM order_items AS oi
    JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY o.branch_id, oi.product_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        branch_id,
        product_id,
        total_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY branch_id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS rn
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT 
    b.id   AS branch_id,
    b.name AS branch_name,
    p.id   AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    r.total_quantity AS quantity_sold
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN branches AS b ON r.branch_id = b.id
JOIN products AS p ON r.product_id = p.id
WHERE r.rn = 1

SELECT 
    c.id,
    c.full_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent_2026
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE substr(o.ordered_at, 1, 4) = '2026'   -- orders placed in the year 2026
GROUP BY c.id, c.full_name
ORDER BY total_spent_2026 DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH branch_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        b.id   AS branch_id,
        b.name AS branch_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.ordered_at, 1, 7) = '2026-08' 
                 THEN oi.unit_price * oi.quantity 
                 ELSE 0 END) AS rev_aug,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.ordered_at, 1, 7) = '2026-09' 
                 THEN oi.unit_price * oi.quantity 
                 ELSE 0 END) AS rev_sep
    FROM branches b
    LEFT JOIN orders o       ON o.branch_id = b.id
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.ordered_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.id, b.name
)
SELECT 
    branch_name,
    (rev_sep - rev_aug) * 100.0 / NULLIF(rev_aug, 0) AS pct_increase
FROM branch_revenue
WHERE rev_aug > 0          -- chỉ xét các chi nhánh có doanh thu tháng 8
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
LIMIT 1
